title: Amnesia Crowd Anthology
description: Otomate’s popular “AMNESIA” anthology is finally here! A new season with “Him”. The long-awaited anthology of “AMNESIA CROWD,” the story after the ending of the previous “AMNESIA LATER”! The main character regains his memory and is united with “Him” from the bottom of his heart. The seasons pass, and new changes come to the happy couple. This is a love story that depicts a sweet and sad romance with characters in new costumes. Shin, a devoted younger childhood friend, Toma, a kind older brother, Icki, a seductive and charming man, Kent, a cool and rational man, and Ukyou, a mysterious and full of gaps. …… Who will you fall in love with? ＡＭＮＥＳＩＡ ＣＲＯＷＤ アンソロジー
